description: This file defines a Go struct and associated methods for configuring a Kubernetes Downward API volume file declaratively, including fields for path, field reference, resource reference, and mode, along with builder methods for chaining configuration.

classes.name: DownwardAPIVolumeFileApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A struct representing the declarative configuration for a Kubernetes Downward API volume file, with fields for path, field reference, resource reference, and mode.
